messages:
Elena (partnerships): Quick sync: Nimbus wants an HW+SI private offer with a 12mo committed spend, an SI onboarding credit, and a joint press window. Need to decide how we model the offer in the marketplace (composite SKU vs linked SKUs) and how SI credits are routed.
Ravi (sales): For AEs we prefer composite SKU for clean quoting. But we need visibility for the SI so they can invoice onboarding work separately.
Tom (finance): Composite SKU ok, but we must track the SI credit as a contra-revenue line or an external rebate. How we account it affects deferred revenue. Also: predict renewal churn if discounts step down.
Lily (partner_ops): Marketplace constraints: some marketplaces reject multi-SKU bundles. Workarounds: single composite SKU with metadata fields for partner_credit_code and partner_invoice_id, or a primary SKU + auxiliary private offer referencing the support SKU. Each has trade-offs.
Nora (legal): Don't forget compliance: SI credit must be non-transferable and narrowly scoped to onboarding. If we provide any refundable credit, contract needs explicit terms. Also require NDA or customer approval for joint press.
Elena (partnerships): Proposal: three tiers (Bronze / Silver / Gold) with escalating committed USD and onboarding credits. Add an accelerator: if customer reaches 120% of committed consumption within first 6 months, route an extra 5% credit to SI.
Tom (finance): Draft numbers: Bronze: 10% discount + $8k SI credit (commit $100k); Silver: 20% + $20k (commit $300k); Gold: 30% + $60k (commit $750k). Acceleration credit paid after milestone verified. Renewal policy: discounts reduce by 7% unless customer signs a 12mo renew at >=80% of prior committed run-rate.
Ravi (sales): Fine. Add a 90-day conversion window for usage-based customers: overage in months 1-3 can be applied to committed base with an automated true-up. That helps close net-new deals.
Nora (legal): Need precise language: "acceleration credit contingent on metered consumption milestones; verification via billing report; credit payable to partner within 45 days of verification." Also add customer approval SLA for joint marketing: 4 business days to sign off or announcement delayed.
Lily (partner_ops): To implement, required marketplace private-offer payload keys: buyer_org, primary_sku, composite_flag, committed_usd, term_months, discount_pct, partner_credit_code, partner_id, si_credit_usd, credit_payment_method (off-invoice | settlement), partner_agreement_ref, marketing_window, marketing_approval_sla_days.
Elena (partnerships): Can you paste a mock payload so sales/legal can see?
Lily (partner_ops): ```
{
  "buyer_org": "Nimbus Technologies",
  "primary_sku": "RWI-HW-SI-GOLD",
  "composite_flag": "true",
  "committed_usd": "750000",
  "term_months": "12",
  "discount_pct": "30",
  "si_credit_usd": "60000",
  "partner_id": "SI-0591",
  "partner_credit_code": "SI-0591-CREDIT-2024",
  "credit_payment_method": "off-invoice",
  "partner_agreement_ref": "PA-2024-0789",
  "marketing_window": "2024-10-01 to 2024-10-14",
  "marketing_approval_sla_days": "4",
  "renewal_stepdown_pct": "7",
  "notes": "Acceleration credit eligible after 120% usage milestone verified"
}
```
Tom (finance): That looks good. Two asks: 1) add an escrow flag if the marketplace supports holding part of the committed funds until usage milestones pass; 2) indicate whether SI credit is recognized as expense or contra-revenue in the payload for downstream ERP mapping.
Lily (partner_ops): Will add escrow_flag and accounting_tag fields. But note: marketplaces rarely surface accounting tags; we'll map on our side.
Ravi (sales): One more ask: can the marketing window be conditional on customer approval? We should include both proposed and fallback dates in the payload.
Nora (legal): Yes include fallback_date and an approval_reminder cadence (e.g., 2 reminders at 3bd and 1bd before the 4bd SLA expires). Also ensure the marketing assets ownership clause is clear.
Elena (partnerships): Action items: Lily to finalize marketplace payload schema and submit by EOD 2024-06-10 to hit the marketplace sync; Tom to model P&L sensitivity with escrow vs no-escrow; Nora to write the SI credit contract clause and marketing SLA; Ravi to build AE one-pager with example quote and conversion window.
